visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a vertical split-screen. The top section shows a viral clip of someone successfully opening a yellow chip bag by hitting it on the floor. In the bottom section, a man with long curly hair and a white T-shirt reacts while holding his phone. (2) The man is seated in a living room on a gray sofa. A large yellow snack bag sits on a wooden coffee table. He prepares to strike it with both palms. (3) He hits the yellow bag forcefully twice. The bag remains sealed. He looks at the camera with a confused and slightly embarrassed expression, gesturing at the unmoving bag. (4) On the third attempt, the bag deflates slightly as air escapes through a small tear, but it does not pop open. He leans in to inspect the failure while continuing to talk. (5) A screen with a beige background and black text serves as a transition between attempts. (6) The man then switches to a blue Lay's snack bag. He strikes it twice with extreme force. On the second hit, the bag bursts open violently from the side and top. (7) A close-up shot focuses on the interior of the opened blue bag, revealing that the impact has completely shattered the potato chips into tiny crumbs and shards. (8) The man sits back, laughing loudly at the result. He picks out a small piece of a chip and puts it in his mouth while smiling. (9) He concludes the video by holding both bags and demonstrating that the messy, jagged openings make them impossible to reseal using standard clips.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, enthusiastic male voice speaking fast Mandarin over an upbeat synth-pop BGM with a strong 4/4 electronic beat. The mood is energetic and curious. (2) A sharp, loud 'thud' occurs as the speaker strikes the table, followed by the background female voice laughing lightly. (3) Repeated hollow impact sounds (thuds) are heard as the speaker tries to break the bag. He lets out a surprised vocalization ('Ah?') when it fails to open. (4) After a quick jump cut, the male speaker continues his fast-paced narration. A series of loud, percussive hitting sounds are heard, ending in a distinct 'hiss' of air and more laughter from the background female. (5) The speaker's tone shifts to high-arousal excitement. A very loud, resonant 'bang' occurs, immediately followed by the sharp 'pop' and 'rip' of a plastic bag bursting. (6) The male speaker shouts in joyful surprise. The audio is then dominated by the intense crinkling and rustling sound of a plastic bag being handled and the rattling of small objects inside. (7) Loud, boisterous male laughter follows. The speaker then returns to a conversational narrative tone, explaining his findings while the crinkling sounds and upbeat BGM continue until the end of the clip.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous challenge vlog testing a viral Korean snack-opening trend. The creator compares the 'toughness' of Taiwanese snack packaging against the trend's requirements, ultimately showing that while the bag might pop with enough force, the chips inside end up completely crushed and the bag becomes difficult to seal, mocking the practicality of the trend.
